items.mainDefect: The retry-exhaustion deletion branch (retryCount > 1) can delete reminders that were later scheduled successfully, because it does not require isScheduled: false and success does not reset retryCount.

secondary.defect: The retry-exhaustion deletion predicate is not restricted to method: SMS, so it also deletes non-SMS reminder rows.

items.mainDefect: The cleanup comment still says it only deletes scheduled SMS reminders whose dates have passed, so it no longer describes the new retry-limit deletion branch.

secondary.defect: The retry-limit deletion branch does not restrict its method to SMS, so it deletes reminders of every method.
